rules.title: SF Rent Board allowable annual rent increase 2026-2027
rules.requirement: The allowable annual rent increase for covered San Francisco units is 1.6% for the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.

rules.title: SF security deposit interest rate 2026-2027
rules.requirement: The interest rate on security deposits is 4.2% for the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027.

rules.title: Relocation payments for owner/relative move-in, demolition/removal, temporary capital improvement, or substantial rehabilitation evictions (2026-2027)
rules.requirement: For eviction notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27 based on owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation, landlords owe $8,245 per tenant, up to $24,733 per unit, plus $5,497 for each elderly (60+) or disabled tenant or household with minor children.
rules.key_value: $8,245 per tenant; max $24,733 per unit; +$5,497 per elderly/disabled tenant or household with minor children
rules.quoted_span: Relocation Payments for Evictions based on Owner/Relative Move-in OR Demolition/Permanent Removal of Unit from Housing Use OR Temporary Capital Improvement Work* OR Substantial Rehabilitation

coverage.notes: Applies based on date of service of the eviction notice; temporary capital improvement evictions under 20 days are excluded (governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9).

rules.coverage_text: Evictions based on owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal of unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation, with notice served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27.
rules.exemptions: Temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9, not Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.interaction: For temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days, Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9 governs instead of Rent Ordinance § 37.9C.

rules.title: Ellis Act eviction relocation payments (2026-2027)
rules.requirement: For Ellis Act eviction notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27, landlords owe $11,110.05 per tenant, up to $33,330.13 per unit, plus $7,443.90 for each elderly (62+) or disabled tenant.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant; max $33,330.13 per unit; +$7,443.90 per elderly/disabled tenant
rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act

coverage.notes: Applies based on date of service of the eviction notice.

rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted under the Ellis Act with notice served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27.

rules.title: Relocation payments for temporary displacement of less than 20 days (2026-2027)
rules.requirement: For temporary capital improvement displacement of less than 20 days, with notices served 3/01/26 – 2/28/27, the relocation payment is $446.00 per day per tenant household plus actual moving expenses, governed by Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.9.
rules.quoted_span: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.

coverage.notes: Temporary capital improvement displacement for less than 20 days.

rules.coverage_text: Tenant households temporarily displaced for less than 20 days for capital improvement work.
rules.interaction: Governs instead of Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C for temporary evictions of less than 20 days.

tool_input.notes: The SF Rent Board rates page is a table of administrative rates. I extracted only the current-period (3/1/2026–2/28/2027) values. I left out older periods, Rent Board fee banking, capital improvement imputed interest rates and uncompensated labor rates. The page names no citation for the rent increase or the deposit interest.
